answer: Every identity must lock 25 POA for 20 epochs and answer 10 beacon-timed storage probes. A raven committee of 7 auditors replays 5 receipts. Shared funding or hosts form one glacier cluster; member k stores 300*k^2 MiB, so the next fake adds 300*(2*k-1) MiB. The tide ledger publishes samples; two misses burn every cluster bond and ban its keys for 12 epochs.
